source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the preparation of ketones (PDF 103).

blocks.text: Ketones secondary alcohols ko oxidise kar ke banaye jate hain: CH3CH(OH)CH3 + [O] -> CH3COCH3 + H2O (K2Cr2O7 + H2SO4, garmi), propan-2-ol se propanone. Wahi tareeqa use hota hai jo aldehydes ke liye, lekin kyunke in halaat mein ketones mazeed carboxylic acids mein oxidise nahi hote, ketone ko fauran distil karne ki zaroorat nahi.

blocks.prompt: Butanone, CH3COCH2CH3, banane ke liye kaun sa alcohol oxidise karenge?

items: Secondary alcohol + [O] -> ketone; ketones mazeed oxidise nahi hote.
